# Release schedule

Forgejo stable releases are published on a fixed schedule, every quarter. The most up-to-date version is available [as a JSON file](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/docs/raw/branch/next/release-schedule.json).

| **Version** | **Cut branch** | **Release date** | **End Of Life** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 7.0 (LTS) | 1 April 2024 | 23 April 2024 | **17 July 2025** |
| 8.0 | 1 July 2024 | 30 July 2024 | 16 October 2024 |
| 9.0 | 25 September 2024 | 16 October 2024 | 16 January 2025 |
| 10.0 | 25 December 2024 | 16 January 2025 | 16 April 2025 |
| 11.0 (LTS) | 26 March 2025 | 16 April 2025 | **16 July 2026** |
| 12.0 | 25 June 2025 | 17 July 2025 | 16 October 2025 |
| 13.0 | 25 September 2025 | 16 October 2025 | 29 January 2026 |
| 14.0 | 18 December 2025 | 15 January 2026 | 30 April 2026 |
| 15.0 (LTS) | 26 March 2026 | 16 April 2026 | **15 July 2027** |
| 16.0 | 25 June 2026 | 16 July 2026 | 29 October 2026 |
| 17.0 | 24 September 2026 | 15 October 2026 | 28 January 2027 |
| 18.0 | 17 December 2026 | 14 January 2027 | 29 April 2027 |
| 19.0 (LTS) | 25 March 2027 | 15 April 2027 | **13 July 2028** |
| 20.0 | 24 June 2027 | 15 July 2027 | 28 October 2027 |
